<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex088052025-05-2616-12-23" status="finalized"><milestone unit="section" n="1.i rigs kyi spyi dang bye brag"/>dang po ni | khyab <note type="gloss">bya ba</note><note type="editorial">phya?</note> che chung ma yin te stong nyid spyi buM pa bye brag du 'gyur la | 'dod na stong nyid mngon sum tshad mas nges par 'gyur ro || khyab <lb n="12a8"/> byed <note type="gloss">yang la la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">kha 1</rs></note> ni spyi | khyab bya ni bye brag ma yin te | mi rtag pa dang yod pa spyi bye brag du thal bas 'dod na mi rtag pa'i don yang mngon sum tshad mas grub par 'gyur ro || ldog pa 1 rkyang dang 2 'tshogs kyang ma yin te | dbyug pa dang dbyug pa can yang der thal ba 'dod na de 2 bdag 1 par 'gyur ro || <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3839">rtsang nag pa</rs></note> rigs mi mthun las log pa'i ldog pa 1 <pb n="12b"/><lb n="12b1"/> rkyang dang | ldog pa 1 rkyang de nyid kyis ldog pa 2 pa zin pa zhes pa | 
        yang spu ris gzung dka' bas | bye brag <choice><reg>de</reg><orig>‹de›</orig></choice> la ltos pa'i zhes gzhir bzhag ste | des na dbyug pa can la de <expan>med</expan> de skyes bu dbyug pa can de skyes bu nang mtshan las log pa'i bye brag yin gyi | dbyug pa nang mtshan las ma log pas dbyug pa'i bye brag ma yin no gsung |
<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4099">kho bo</rs> <lb n="12b2"/> ni | nang mtshan du ma phye bar ril por brjod pa 'am bsaMs pa ni spyi la | phye ba ni bye brag du 'thad do bsaM mo ||</seg></TEI>
source: 3_088_05 Chos kyi bzhad pa_tshad ma de kho na nyid nye bar bsdus pa.xml
